# 7474 - Dual D-type edge-triggered flip-flop

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7474.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7474.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 17 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7474 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7474.png) | ![7474 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7474.png) | ![7474 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7474.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1CLR | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 5, 6 |
| 2 | 1D | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1CK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 4 | 1PR | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 5, 6 |
| 5 | 1Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | /1Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 8 | /2Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 2Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 10 | 2PR | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9, 8 |
| 11 | 2CK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 12 | 2D | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 2CLR | input | low |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9, 8 |
| 14 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 1Q = state1 | Stored bit of flip-flop 1. |
| 6 | /1Q = NOT state1 | Inverse of 1Q (both high while 1PR and 1CLR are both low). |
| 9 | 2Q = state2 | Stored bit of flip-flop 2. |
| 8 | /2Q = NOT state2 | Inverse of 2Q (both high while 2PR and 2CLR are both low). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 2

Changes on: rising edge of nCK, each flip-flop on its own clock

- PR low, CLR high: Q = 1, Q' = 0 at once
- PR high, CLR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once
- PR low, CLR low: Q = 1 and Q' = 1; not stable, does not persist when PR and CLR return high
- PR high, CLR high, rising edge of CK: Q = D
- PR high, CLR high, CK low: hold

|---|---|

| inputSchmitt | no |

| 1CK | /1Q | PHL | 20 | 40 |
| 2PR | 2Q | PLH |  | 25 |
| 2PR | /2Q | PHL |  | 40 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
